bibliographic.title: Tales of Nivea: GRIP
bibliographic.author: Arlo Inthaphone
bibliographic.description:
The Godborn Registry and Intake Program exists to keep everyone safe. That's what they tell you on your first day, and you mostly believe it, the way you believe most things you haven't been asked to look closely at yet.

GRIP is a choice-based bureaucratic-horror visual novel: ten cases, one office, and a stamp that gets heavier every time you use it. What you decide changes who lives free, who lives watched, and who stops living at all. By the end, it will have quietly decided something about you, too.

Content warning: Domestic abuse and violence
